text: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Inflammatory bowel disease, also called IBD, is an umbrella term for a group of conditions that cause swelling and inflammation of the tissues in the digestive tract.

name: Tonsil cancer
text: Tonsil cancer. Tonsil cancer is a growth of cells that starts in a tonsil. The tonsils are two oval-shaped pads in the back of the mouth. They help the immune system fight germs.

name: Heart arrhythmia
text: Heart arrhythmia. A heart arrhythmia (uh-RITH-me-uh) is an irregular heartbeat. A heart arrhythmia occurs when the electrical signals that tell the heart to beat don't work properly. The heart may beat too fast or too slow. Or the pattern of the heartbeat may be inconsistent.

name: Uterine fibroids
text: Uterine fibroids. Uterine fibroids are common growths of the uterus. They often appear during the years you're usually able to get pregnant and give birth. Uterine fibroids are not cancer, and they almost never turn into cancer. They aren't linked with a higher risk of other types of cancer in the uterus either. They're also called leiomyomas (lie-o-my-O-muhs) or myomas.

name: Tinnitus
text: Tinnitus. Tinnitus is when you experience ringing or other noises in one or both of your ears. The noise you hear when you have tinnitus isn't caused by an external sound, and other people usually can't hear it. Tinnitus is a common problem. It affects about 15% to 20% of people, and is especially common in older adults.

name: Dust mite allergy
text: Dust mite allergy.

name: DiGeorge syndrome (22q11.2 deletion syndrome)
text: DiGeorge syndrome (22q11.2 deletion syndrome). DiGeorge syndrome, also known as 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, is a condition caused when a small part of chromosome 22 is missing. This deletion causes several body systems to develop poorly.

name: Down syndrome
text: Down syndrome. Down syndrome is a genetic condition caused when an unusual cell division results in an extra full or partial copy of chromosome 21. This extra genetic material causes the developmental changes and physical features of Down syndrome.

name: Interstitial cystitis
text: Interstitial cystitis.

name: Color blindness
text: Color blindness. Color blindness is an eye condition in which someone can't see the difference between certain colors. Though many people commonly use the term "color blind" for this condition, true color blindness — in which everything is seen in shades of black and white — is rare. The medical term for color blindness is known as color vision deficiency.

name: Sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS)
text: Sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS). Sudden infant death syndrome is the unexplained death of a baby. The baby is usually less than a year old and seems to be healthy. It often happens during sleep. Sudden infant death syndrome also is known as SIDS. It is sometimes called crib death because infants often die in their cribs.

name: Salmonella infection
text: Salmonella infection.

name: Folliculitis
text: Folliculitis.

name: Uterine polyps
text: Uterine polyps.

name: Boils and carbuncles
text: Boils and carbuncles.

name: Mood disorders
text: Mood disorders. Mood disorders, such as depression and bipolar disorder, affect people emotionally. If you have depression, you may constantly feel sad. You also may be anxious. If you have bipolar disorder, you'll likely have extreme mood swings. Your feelings may range from being very sad, empty or cranky to being very happy — going back and forth between each mood. Mood disorders are more common in women.

name: Metastatic (stage 4) prostate cancer
text: Metastatic (stage 4) prostate cancer. Metastatic prostate cancer is cancer that starts in the prostate and spreads to other parts of the body. Other terms for this condition include advanced prostate cancer and stage 4 prostate cancer.

name: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection
text: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection.

name: Parvovirus infection
text: Parvovirus infection.

name: Bulimia nervosa
text: Bulimia nervosa. Bulimia (boo-LEE-me-uh) nervosa, commonly called bulimia, is a serious, potentially life-threatening eating disorder. People with bulimia binge eat. This means people feel like they've lost control over their eating. They eat large amounts of food in one sitting. This often occurs in secret, and they often feel very guilty and shameful. Then they try to get rid of the food and extra calories in an unhealthy way, such as vomiting or misusing laxatives. This is called purging.

name: Small bowel prolapse (enterocele)
text: Small bowel prolapse (enterocele). Small bowel prolapse, also called enterocele (EN-tur-o-seel), occurs when the small intestine (small bowel) descends into the lower pelvic cavity and pushes at the top part of the vagina, creating a bulge. The word "prolapse" means to slip or fall out of place.
